thesis: This episode argues that the NFL is a highly valuable media product with global addressability, strong cultural relevance, and excellent revenue prediction capabilities, with revenue on track to surpass $25 billion by 2027. It also highlights the NFL's strategic wins with Disney/ESPN and the success of Thursday Night Football on Prime, positioning the league as a top-tier American media league.
